hard_think: WSP 15 scored current-truth retrieval drift at 18/P0 because a usable semantic system that answers status from stale audits can direct subsequent autonomous work incorrectly.

The smallest scalable layer is file-role authority plus path-bound current sections and a separate one-summary-per-document semantic stream; unbounded oversampling, query-specific paths, or declaring all README sections current were rejected.

A-grade and retrieval RSI are separate P0 layers. Current-truth ranking cannot substitute for exact runtime payload closure, a disjoint sealed evaluator, passing generic quality metrics, signed promotion, canary, rollback, or outcome learning.

Authority sorting before limit fixes stale-first ordering but not same-file section crowding; the filtered summary stream preserves bounded path diversity without increasing the candidate ceiling indefinitely.

first_principles: Current-state answers must prefer reviewed current contracts, then implementation evidence, while explicit historical and exact-artifact queries retain semantic intent.
A retrieval system scales only when bounded K still permits source diversity; candidate caps cannot be the sole defense against repeated chunks from one document.
RSI requires a closed authenticated propose-evaluate-admit-promote-observe-rollback loop whose outcomes bind to the exact candidate. Observation and pinned evaluation alone are not RSI.
The RedDog VSIX remains a thin consumer of governed read-only evidence and receives no Holo write, reindex, maintenance, dispatch, evaluation-admission, or promotion authority.
